components.name: Input

narrative.overview: Neobrutalism with discipline: a confident, engineered poster system where every block is load-bearing. Hard ink borders and solid offset shadows give the page a printed, tactile weight, while a five-acid accent palette over a warm cream base keeps it playful rather than corporate. Structure sits underneath the loudness — the grid is intentional, the spacing breathes, and the motion is choreographed, not scattered. The site itself is the strongest proof of frontend ability, so the visual system must read as real, serious, and recruiter-ready within two minutes of arrival. The system rejects generic corporate-minimal SaaS templates, bland beige placeholders, cartoonish doodle illustrations, and muted washed-out palettes.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners everywhere (radius 0); hardness is the signature.
Solid, zero-blur offset shadows in ink (#1a1a1a) — structure, not glow.
One family (Space Grotesk) carried in multiple weights.
A committed five-accent palette over a cream base; color used decisively.
Bordered kicker badges open every section — a deliberate brand system.
Framer Motion entrance choreography with reduced-motion honored.

rules.name: The One Accent Per Block Rule
rules.body: A given block commits to ONE accent role. Rotate the accent between sibling blocks instead of mixing two inside one card.

rules.name: The Cream Base Rule
rules.body: Full-bleed page backgrounds are Cream (#FFF5EB). White is reserved for cards and panels that sit on top of the cream.

rules.name: The Saturated, Not Washed Rule
rules.body: Every accent is high-chroma and unapologetic. Never desaturate an accent for elegance; shift lightness, not chroma.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk is the only typeface. Differentiate through weight, scale, and accent color — never a second font.

rules.name: The Kicker Badge Rule
rules.body: Section labels are bordered, shadowed, accent-backed badges. A lone tracked eyebrow above a heading is prohibited.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is a solid #1a1a1a (or single accent) offset with 0 blur. Soft, blurred, or gradient shadows are forbidden.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements translate toward their shadow on press: translate(2px,2px) hover, translate(4px,4px) active, shadow collapses to 0.

dos: Do use solid, zero-blur ink shadows (6px 6px 0 #1a1a1a) for all elevation.
Do commit each block to a single accent; rotate accents across siblings.
Do open every section with a bordered, shadowed kicker badge.
Do press buttons on interaction: translate toward the shadow, collapse the offset.
Do keep body copy in ink/secondary on cream; verify >=4.5:1.
Do use Space Grotesk only; differentiate with weight, scale, accent color.
donts: Don't use soft, blurred, or gradient shadows — the generic modern SaaS look this brand rejects.
Don't desaturate or mute the accents for elegance; muted washed-out palette is an anti-reference.
Don't put a white background on a full page; the base is Cream. White is for cards only.
Don't add a second typeface for contrast; single-family is deliberate.
Don't float a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above a heading without its bordered badge.
Don't introduce cartoonish doodle illustrations as personality; playful means loud color and structure.
Don't replace neobrutalist structure with glassmorphism, side-stripe accent borders, or gradient text.
Don't let body text fall below 4.5:1 contrast.
